summary.one_liner: Agency AI is a consulting firm that builds custom AI agents for startups and enterprises, offering AI agent development, observability and AgentOps services.

summary.what_it_does: The page describes Agency as an AI agent consulting firm that builds custom AI agents for startups and enterprises, including Fortune 500 companies. It says it helps clients prototype and productionize agents that are safe and provide positive ROI. The page states it has built and reviewed hundreds of custom agents since 2023. Clients can send a job posting and Agency says it will build a custom agent for that role. The meta description also mentions AI agent developer tools, observability, and AgentOps, but the body text gives few specifics about these products.
notable: Custom AI agents built to a job posting, pitched as a 24/7/365 replacement for a 40-hour-per-week employee
Has built and reviewed hundreds of custom AI agents since 2023, per the page
Offers AgentOps and observability tooling according to the meta description
caveats: Pricing and engagement terms are not stated on the page
The page is mostly marketing copy with few concrete technical details about its tools
